test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Rs. 2400 is lent at the rate of 10 percent per annum. Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct? 

I. The compound interest (compounding annually) for 3 years is Rs. 794.4.

II. The difference between simple interest and compound interest (compounding annually) after 3 years is Rs. 75.8

options.text: None of the statements are correct
Both statement I and II are correct

solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 2400

Rate of interest per annum (R) = 10% 

**Concept used:**

Amount = P(1 + R/100)T

Compound interest = Amount – P

**Calculation:**

From statement I.

Amount = 2400(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 2400(1 + 1/10)³

⇒ 2400 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ (2400/1331) × 1000

⇒ 2.4&
